name: Langfuse
summary: Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and observing LLM apps and agents, with a free cloud Hobby plan and a self-hosted option.
description: Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and observing LLM apps and agents, with a free cloud Hobby plan and a self-hosted option.

pricing.details: Langfuse Cloud: Hobby Free 0 €, no credit card — all platform features with limits, 50k units/month included, 30 days of data access, 2 users, community support via GitHub. Core 26 €/month — everything in Hobby, 100k units/month included then 7 €/100k (lower with volume), 90 days of data access, unlimited users, in-app support. Pro 180 €/month — everything in Core, 100k units included then 7 €/100k, 3 years of data access, retention management, high rate limits, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 reports, HIPAA-ready region, prioritized support. Optional Teams add-on 271 €/month (SSO, RBAC, dedicated Slack/Teams support). Enterprise 2,261 €/month (talk to sales). Startup, EDU and OSS discounts are mentioned without public amounts. Official self-hosting is also offered.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Open-source tracing, evaluation and observability for LLM apps and agents, with an official self-host option
Traces and graphs, session and user tracking, token and cost tracking, plus prompt and evaluation tools
Hobby Cloud is free with limits; Core and Pro add volume, retention and in-app support
Langfuse has joined ClickHouse; Cloud pricing remains published on langfuse.com
